Script.name: m_enchanter_core
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- m_Enchanter - Mudlet enchanting helper backed by DINV persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
m_Enchanter = m_Enchanter or {} m_Enchanter.version = "1.2.2" m_Enchanter.aliases = m_Enchanter.aliases or {} m_Enchanter.triggers = m_Enchanter.triggers or {} m_Enchanter.timers = m_Enchanter.timers or {} m_Enchanter.events = m_Enchanter.events or {} m_Enchanter.pending_identifies = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies or {} m_Enchanter.active_command_queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue or nil m_Enchanter.next_operation_id = tonumber(m_Enchanter.next_operation_id) or 0 m_Enchanter.batch = m_Enchanter.batch or { status = "idle" }
m_Enchanter.settings = m_Enchanter.settings or { debug = false, reporting_on = true, report_channel = "echo", quiet = false, focus_ignore = false, } m_Enchanter.settings.batch = m_Enchanter.settings.batch or {} m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates or {} m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers or {}
m_Enchanter.focus = m_Enchanter.focus or { status = "unknown" } m_Enchanter.pending_command = m_Enchanter.pending_command or "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = m_Enchanter.pending_item_id or "" m_Enchanter.last = m_Enchanter.last or nil
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- General helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function startsWith(value, prefix) return tostring(value or ""):sub(1, #prefix) == prefix end
local function tableCount(t) local n = 0 if type(t) == "table" then for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function shallowCopy(t) local out = {} if type(t) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = v end end return out end
local function deepCopy(value, seen) if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end seen = seen or {} if seen[value] then return seen[value] end local out = {} seen[value] = out for key, item in pairs(value) do out[deepCopy(key, seen)] = deepCopy(item, seen) end return out end
local function sortedKeys(t) local keys = {} for key in pairs(t or {}) do table.insert(keys, key) end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a):lower() < tostring(b):lower() end) return keys end
local function safeCall(callback, ...) if type(callback) ~= "function" then return true end local ok, err = pcall(callback, ...) if not ok then m_Enchanter.warn("Callback failed: " .. tostring(err)) end return ok, err end
local function stripColors(text) if dbot and dbot.stripColors then return dbot.stripColors(text) end text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x%d+", "") text = text:gsub("@[%a]", "") text = text:gsub("\027%[[%d;]*m", "") text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.convertColors(text) if dbot and dbot.convertColors then return dbot.convertColors(text) end
local map = { ["@w"] = "<ansi_white>", ["@W"] = "<white>", ["@r"] = "<ansi_red>", ["@R"] = "<ansi_light_red>", ["@g"] = "<ansi_green>", ["@G"] = "<ansi_light_green>", ["@y"] = "<ansi_yellow>", ["@Y"] = "<ansi_light_yellow>", ["@b"] = "<ansi_blue>", ["@B"] = "<ansi_light_blue>", ["@m"] = "<ansi_magenta>", ["@M"] = "<ansi_light_magenta>", ["@c"] = "<ansi_cyan>", ["@C"] = "<ansi_light_cyan>", ["@d"] = "<ansi_black>", ["@D"] = "<ansi_light_black>", }
local function xtermToMudlet(num) num = tonumber(num) or 0 if num == 0 then return "<ansi_black>" elseif num == 1 then return "<ansi_red>" elseif num == 2 then return "<ansi_green>" elseif num == 3 then return "<ansi_yellow>" elseif num == 4 then return "<ansi_blue>" elseif num == 5 then return "<ansi_magenta>" elseif num == 6 then return "<ansi_cyan>" elseif num == 7 then return "<ansi_white>" elseif num == 8 then return "<ansi_light_black>" elseif num == 9 then return "<ansi_light_red>" elseif num == 10 then return "<ansi_light_green>" elseif num == 11 then return "<ansi_light_yellow>" elseif num == 12 then return "<ansi_light_blue>" elseif num == 13 then return "<ansi_light_magenta>" elseif num == 14 then return "<ansi_light_cyan>" elseif num == 15 then return "<white>" elseif num >= 232 then local grey = num - 232 if grey < 8 then return "<ansi_black>" elseif grey < 16 then return "<ansi_light_black>" else return "<white>" end end
local cube = num - 16 local blue = cube % 6 local green = math.floor(cube / 6) % 6 local red = math.floor(cube / 36) local bright = math.max(red, green, blue) >= 3 if red > green and red > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_red>" or "<ansi_red>" elseif green > red and green > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_green>" or "<ansi_green>" elseif blue > red and blue > green then return bright and "<ansi_light_blue>" or "<ansi_blue>" elseif red == green and red > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_yellow>" or "<ansi_yellow>" elseif red == blue and red > green then return bright and "<ansi_light_magenta>" or "<ansi_magenta>" elseif green == blue and green > red then return bright and "<ansi_light_cyan>" or "<ansi_cyan>" else return bright and "<white>" or "<ansi_white>" end end
text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x(%d+)", xtermToMudlet) for code, color in pairs(map) do text = text:gsub(code:gsub("@", "%%@"), color) end text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.print(text) cecho(m_Enchanter.convertColors(tostring(text or "")) .. "\n") end
function m_Enchanter.info(text) m_Enchanter.print("@C[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.warn(text) m_Enchanter.print("@Y[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.debug(text) if m_Enchanter.settings.debug then m_Enchanter.print("@D[m_enchanter DEBUG] " .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end end
local function quoteTarget(target) target = trim(target) if target == "" then return target end if target:match("^%d+$") then return target end if target:find("%s") then return "'" .. target:gsub("'", "\\'") .. "'" end return target end
local function sendGameCommand(command) if m_Enchanter.settings.quiet then if sendSilent then sendSilent(command) else send(command, false) end else send(command) end end
local function sendToDestination(destination, coloredText) local channel = trim(destination or "echo") if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end
if channel:lower() == "echo" then m_Enchanter.print(coloredText) return end
if channel:lower() == "gchan" then local message = tostring(coloredText or "") if _G.GCH and type(GCH.send_gchan) == "function" then GCH.send_gchan(message) elseif expandAlias then expandAlias("gchan " .. message, false) else send("gchan " .. message, false) end return end
local mudChannels = { clan = true, say = true, gtell = true, gt = true, spouse = true, }
if mudChannels[channel:lower()] then -- Aardwolf channels understand Aardwolf @ color codes. send(channel .. " " .. tostring(coloredText or ""), false) elseif expandAlias then -- Custom client channels do not reliably understand Aardwolf/xterm -- markup. Do not leak literal @xNNN codes into them. expandAlias(channel .. " " .. stripColors(coloredText), false) else m_Enchanter.warn("Cannot report to custom channel '" .. channel .. "': Mudlet alias expansion is unavailable.") end end
local function sendReportLine(coloredText) sendToDestination(m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo", coloredText) end
local function niceJoin(list) list = shallowCopy(list) if #list == 0 then return "" end if #list == 1 then return list[1] end local last = table.remove(list) return table.concat(list, ", ") .. ", and " .. last end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getHomeDir() if getMudletHomeDir then return getMudletHomeDir() end return "." end
local function ensureDirectory(path) path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/") if path == "" then return false end
local ok, lfsLib = pcall(require, "lfs") local fs = ok and lfsLib or lfs if not fs then return false end
local current = "" local drive = path:match("^%a:") if drive then current = drive path = path:sub(3) elseif startsWith(path, "/") then current = "/" end
for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do if current == "" then current = segment elseif current == "/" then current = current .. segment else current = current .. "/" .. segment end
if fs.attributes(current, "mode") ~= "directory" then fs.mkdir(current) end end
return true end
function m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() return getHomeDir() .. "/persistence/" end
function m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath() return m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "m_enchanter.state" end
local function saveLuaTable(path, tableName, value) local dir = path:match("^(.*[/\\])[^/\\]+$") if dir then ensureDirectory(dir) end
local function serialize(v, indent) indent = indent or 0 local tv = type(v) if tv == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) elseif tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" then return tostring(v) elseif tv == "table" then local parts = { "{" } local nextIndent = indent + 4 local keys = {} for k in pairs(v) do table.insert(keys, k) end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local keyText if type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then keyText = k else keyText = "[" .. serialize(k, nextIndent) .. "]" end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", nextIndent) .. keyText .. " = " .. serialize(v[k], nextIndent) .. ",") end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", indent) .. "}") return table.concat(parts, "\n") end return "nil" end
local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not save settings: " .. tostring(err)) return false end f:write(tableName .. " = " .. serialize(value, 0) .. "\n") f:close() return true end
local function loadLuaFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil end local content = f:read("*a") f:close() if not content or content == "" then return nil end
local env = { inv = { items = {} } } setmetatable(env, { __index = _G })
local chunk, err if loadstring then chunk, err = loadstring(content) if chunk and setfenv then setfenv(chunk, env) end else chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. path, "t", env) end
if not chunk then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not parse persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(err)) return nil end
local ok, runErr = pcall(chunk) if not ok then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not load persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(runErr)) return nil end
return env end
function m_Enchanter.saveSettings() local data = { debug = m_Enchanter.settings.debug and true or false, reporting_on = m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on and true or false, report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo", quiet = m_Enchanter.settings.quiet and true or false, focus_ignore = m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore and true or false, batch = deepCopy(m_Enchanter.settings.batch or {}), } saveLuaTable(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath(), "m_EnchanterSettings", data) end
function m_Enchanter.loadSettings() local env = loadLuaFile(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath()) local data = env and env.m_EnchanterSettings if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
for k, v in pairs(data) do m_Enchanter.settings[k] = v end m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo" m_Enchanter.settings.batch = m_Enchanter.settings.batch or {} m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates or {} m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers or {} end
function m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths() local paths = {} local seen = {} local function add(path) if path and path ~= "" and not seen[path] then seen[path] = true table.insert(paths, path) end end
add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "inv-items.state") add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "dinv/inv-items.state")
if dbot and dbot.backup and dbot.backup.getCurrentDir then local ok, dir = pcall(dbot.backup.getCurrentDir) if ok and dir then local separator = tostring(dir):match("[/\\]$") and "" or "/" add(tostring(dir) .. separator .. "inv-items.state") end end
return paths end
function m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if inv and inv.items and inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable then local ok, items = pcall(inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable) if ok and type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, "dinv" end end
for _, path in ipairs(m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths()) do local env = loadLuaFile(path) local items = env and env.inv and env.inv.items and env.inv.items.table if type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, path end end
return nil, nil end
function m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "live" end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.load then pcall(inv.items.load) if type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "dinv-load" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if items and inv and inv.items and (type(inv.items.table) ~= "table" or tableCount(inv.items.table) == 0) then inv.items.table = items end return items, source end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DINV access ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.dinvReady() if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.isReady) == "function" then local ok, ready = pcall(DINV.api.isReady) if ok and ready then return true end end return inv and inv.items and inv.items.search and inv.items.getItem end
function m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() if not m_Enchanter.dinvReady() then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV is not loaded. Load DINV first; numeric ids can still be read from persistence if inv-items.state exists.") return false end m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() return true end
function m_Enchanter.runDinvSearch(query) query = trim(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return false end
if inv.cli and inv.cli.main then inv.cli.main("search " .. query) return true end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") return true end
return false end
function m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return nil, -1 end
if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.search) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.search, query, { fields = { "id" } }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok then local itemIds = {} for _, item in ipairs(result.items or {}) do if item.id ~= nil then table.insert(itemIds, tostring(item.id)) end end return itemIds, 0 end end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) itemIds = itemIds or {} if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end end return itemIds, retval end
function m_Enchanter.displayItemIds(itemIds) if not itemIds or #itemIds == 0 then return end if inv and inv.items and inv.items.displayResults then inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") end end
function m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return nil end
if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.getItem) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getItem, objId, { detail = "raw" }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok and type(result.item) == "table" then return result.item, "DINV.api" end end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.getItem then local item = inv.items.getItem(objId) if item then return item, "live" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if type(items) == "table" then local item = items[objId] or items[tonumber(objId)] if item then return item, source or "persistence" end end
return nil, nil end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Item/stat helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local fieldCandidates = { id = { "id" }, name = { "name" }, colorName = { "colorname", "colorName", "coloredName" }, flags = { "flags" }, enchants = { "enchants", "enchantments", "enchantData", "enchantDetails" }, solidify = { "solidify" }, resonate = { "resonate" }, illuminate = { "illuminate" }, solidifyRemoval = { "solidifyremoval", "solidifyRemoval" }, resonateRemoval = { "resonateremoval", "resonateRemoval" }, illuminateRemoval = { "illuminateremoval", "illuminateRemoval" }, type = { "type" }, level = { "level" }, wearable = { "wearable" }, location = { "location", "loc" }, container = { "container" }, worn = { "worn" }, identifyLevel = { "identifyLevel", "idlevel" }, }
local function getStat(item, key) if not item then return nil end local stats = item.stats or item local candidates = fieldCandidates[key] or { key } for _, field in ipairs(candidates) do if stats[field] ~= nil then return stats[field] end if item[field] ~= nil then return item[field] end end return nil end
local function getDinvStat(objId, globalFieldName, fallbackField) if not (inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.getStatField) == "function") then return nil end
local field = rawget(_G, globalFieldName) or fallbackField if not field then return nil end
local ok, value = pcall(inv.items.getStatField, tostring(objId or ""), field) if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then return value end return nil end
local function normalizeTokenText(text) text = stripColors(text):lower() text = text:gsub("[,;|/]+", " ") return text end
local function hasToken(text, token) token = tostring(token or ""):lower() for word in normalizeTokenText(text):gmatch("%S+") do if word == token then return true end end return false end
local function cleanDisplayName(name) name = tostring(name or "") name = name:gsub("%s+[A-Z][a-z]+%s+%+?%-?%d+%s*%(removable[^%)]*%).*", "") name = name:gsub("%s+%(removable[^%)]*%)%s*", "") return trim(name) end
local function itemIsInInventory(item) return tostring(getStat(item, "location") or ""):lower() == "inventory" end
local function normalizeEnchantKind(value) value = tostring(value or ""):lower() if value:find("solid") then return "solidify" elseif value:find("reson") then return "resonate" elseif value:find("illum") then return "illuminate" end return nil end
local function addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) kind = normalizeEnchantKind(kind) if not kind then return end details[kind] = details[kind] or {} table.insert(details[kind], { value = trim(value or ""), removable = trim(removable or ""), }) end
local function parseEnchantString(details, text) text = tostring(text or "") if text == "" then return end
for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local chunks = {} if line:find(":", 1, true) then table.insert(chunks, line) else for part in line:gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(chunks, part) end end if #chunks == 0 then table.insert(chunks, line) end
for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do local kind = normalizeEnchantKind(chunk) if kind then local removable = chunk:match("%((.-)%)") or "" local value = chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*%(") or chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if value:lower():find("removable", 1, true) then value = "" end addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) end end end end
local function parseEnchantTable(details, value, impliedKind) if type(value) ~= "table" then if type(value) == "string" then if impliedKind then local removable = value:match("%((.-)%)") or "" local statValue = value:match("^(.-)%s*%(") or value if statValue:lower():find("removable", 1, true) then removable = removable ~= "" and removable or statValue statValue = "" end addEnchant(details, impliedKind, statValue, removable) else parseEnchantString(details, value) end end return end
local hasNumeric = false for k in pairs(value) do if type(k) == "number" then hasNumeric = true break end end
if hasNumeric then for _, entry in ipairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, entry, impliedKind) end return end
local kind = impliedKind or normalizeEnchantKind(value.kind or value.name or value.type or "") local removable = value.removable or value.remove or value.removal or value.source or value[2] or "" local statValue = value.value or value.stat or value.mod or value.amount or value[1] or "" if kind then addEnchant(details, kind, statValue, removable) else for k, v in pairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, v, normalizeEnchantKind(k)) end end end
local function getEnchantDetails(item) local details = { solidify = {}, resonate = {}, illuminate = {}, } local raw = getStat(item, "enchants") if type(raw) == "table" then parseEnchantTable(details, raw, nil) elseif type(raw) == "string" then parseEnchantString(details, raw) end
-- Current DINV stores the enchant list in `enchants`, but stores each -- enchant's values and removal mode in dedicated stat fields. for _, kind in ipairs({ "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" }) do local statValue = getStat(item, kind) local removal = getStat(item, kind .. "Removal") if statValue ~= nil or removal ~= nil then details[kind] = {} addEnchant(details, kind, statValue or "", removal or "") end end return details end
local function hasEnchant(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] return type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 end
local function enchantRemovalMode(details, kind) local mode = "" for _, entry in ipairs(details and details[kind] or {}) do local removal = tostring(entry.removable or ""):lower() if removal:find("enchanter", 1, true) then return "enchanter" elseif removal:find("tp", 1, true) then mode = "tp" elseif removal ~= "" and mode == "" then mode = "other" end end return mode end
local function removableText(raw) raw = tostring(raw or ""):lower() if raw == "" then return "" end if raw:find("tp", 1, true) then return "@r(removable with TP only)@w" end if raw:find("enchanter", 1, true) then return "@y(removable by enchanter)@w" end if raw:find("removable", 1, true) then return "@y(" .. raw .. ")@w" end return "" end
local function formatEnchantDetails(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then return nil end
local values = {} local removable = "" for _, entry in ipairs(list) do if entry.value and entry.value ~= "" then table.insert(values, entry.value) end local rt = removableText(entry.removable) if rt ~= "" then removable = rt end end
if #values > 0 then return "@W" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. "@w" .. (removable ~= "" and (" " .. removable) or "") end if removable ~= "" then return "@WEnchanted@w " .. removable end return "@WAlready enchanted.@w" end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Analysis ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.buildAnalysis(objId, item, enchantDetailsOverride) local rawFlags = getStat(item, "flags") local flagParts = {} if type(rawFlags) == "table" then for key, value in pairs(rawFlags) do if type(key) == "number" then table.insert(flagParts, tostring(value)) elseif value == true or value == 1 or value == "1" then table.insert(flagParts, tostring(key)) elseif type(value) == "string" then table.insert(flagParts, value) end end table.sort(flagParts) end local flags = type(rawFlags) == "table" and table.concat(flagParts, " ") or tostring(rawFlags or "") local details = getEnchantDetails(item) for _, kind in ipairs({ "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" }) do local captured = enchantDetailsOverride and enchantDetailsOverride[kind] if type(captured) == "table" and #captured > 0 then details[kind] = shallowCopy(captured) end end
local hasInvis = hasToken(flags, "invis") local hasHum = hasToken(flags, "hum") local hasGlow = hasToken(flags, "glow") local hasSolidified = hasToken(flags, "solidified") or hasEnchant(details, "solidify") local hasResonated = hasToken(flags, "resonated") or hasEnchant(details, "resonate") local hasIlluminated = hasToken(flags, "illuminated") or hasEnchant(details, "illuminate")
-- Read DINV's canonical database field first. API result shapes differ -- between DINV versions, while getStatField consistently resolves it. local colorName = getDinvStat(objId, "invStatFieldColorName", "colorname") or getStat(item, "colorName") or getStat(item, "name") or ("item " .. tostring(objId)) colorName = cleanDisplayName(colorName) local plainName = cleanDisplayName(stripColors(colorName)) if plainName == "" then plainName = "item " .. tostring(objId) end
local lines = {} local flagsToToggle = {}
local solidifyStatus if hasSolidified then solidifyStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "solidify") or "@CAlready solidified.@w" elseif hasInvis then solidifyStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" else solidifyStatus = "@RNeeds 'invis' flag ON@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "invis") end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CSolidify@w: " .. solidifyStatus)
local resonateStatus if hasResonated then resonateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "resonate") or "@CAlready resonated.@w" elseif hasHum then resonateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "hum") else resonateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CResonate@w: " .. resonateStatus)
local illuminateStatus if hasIlluminated then illuminateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "illuminate") or "@CAlready illuminated.@w" elseif hasGlow then illuminateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "glow") else illuminateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CIlluminate@w: " .. illuminateStatus)
local target = tostring(objId or plainName) local pending = "" if #flagsToToggle > 0 then pending = "setflag " .. quoteTarget(target) .. " " .. table.concat(flagsToToggle, " ") end
return { id = tostring(objId or ""), item = item, colorName = colorName, plainName = plainName, flags = flags, lines = lines, pending = pending, hasInvis = hasInvis, hasHum = hasHum, hasGlow = hasGlow, hasSolidified = hasSolidified, hasResonated = hasResonated, hasIlluminated = hasIlluminated, enchantDetails = details, removalModes = { solidify = enchantRemovalMode(details, "solidify"), resonate = enchantRemovalMode(details, "resonate"), illuminate = enchantRemovalMode(details, "illuminate"), }, } end
function m_Enchanter.displayAnalysis(analysis) local title = "@DEnchantment Analysis for @w" .. analysis.colorName .. "@D (@Y" .. analysis.id .. local BATCH_KIND_ORDER = { "solidify", "illuminate", "resonate" } local BATCH_KIND_LETTER = { solidify = "S", illuminate = "I", resonate = "R" } local BATCH_LETTER_KIND = { S = "solidify", I = "illuminate", R = "resonate" } local BATCH_KIND_PRETTY = { solidify = "Solidify", illuminate = "Illuminate", resonate = "Resonate" }
function m_Enchanter.batchIsActive() local status = m_Enchanter.batch and m_Enchanter.batch.status or "idle" return status ~= "idle" end
local function batchInfo(text) m_Enchanter.print("@C" .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end
local function batchWarn(text) m_Enchanter.print("@Y" .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end
local function batchError(text) m_Enchanter.print("@R" .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end
local function batchTokenize(text) text = tostring(text or "") local tokens = {} local index = 1 while index <= #text do while index <= #text and text:sub(index, index):match("%s") do index = index + 1 end if index > #text then break end
if text:sub(index, index) == "{" then local depth = 1 local startAt = index + 1 index = index + 1 while index <= #text and depth > 0 do local ch = text:sub(index, index) if ch == "{" then depth = depth + 1 elseif ch == "}" then depth = depth - 1 end index = index + 1 end if depth ~= 0 then return nil, "Unclosed '{' in batch command." end table.insert(tokens, { value = text:sub(startAt, index - 2), braced = true }) else local startAt = index while index <= #text and not text:sub(index, index):match("%s") do index = index + 1 end table.insert(tokens, { value = text:sub(startAt, index - 1), braced = false }) end end return tokens end
local function batchParseRecipe(raw, mode) local compact = tostring(raw or ""):upper():gsub("[%s,]+", "") if compact == "" then return nil, "The " .. tostring(mode or "recipe") .. " definition is empty." end
local entries = {} local remaining = compact while remaining ~= "" do local letter, amount, rest = remaining:match("^([SIR])(%d+)(.*)$") if not letter then return nil, "Invalid enchant token near '" .. remaining .. "'. Use tokens such as I5, S6, or R3." end table.insert(entries, { kind = BATCH_LETTER_KIND[letter], letter = letter, target = tonumber(amount), }) remaining = rest end
if mode == "cleanup" then local seen = {} for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do if seen[entry.kind] then return nil, "Cleanup definitions may contain each enchant family only once." end seen[entry.kind] = true end end
local families = {} local byKind = {} local lastKind = nil for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local family = byKind[entry.kind] if not family then family = { kind = entry.kind, letter = entry.letter, targets = {} } byKind[entry.kind] = family table.insert(families, family) elseif lastKind ~= entry.kind then return nil, "Fallback tokens for the same enchant family must be adjacent." end table.insert(family.targets, entry.target) if mode == "recipe" and #family.targets > 2 then return nil, "A recipe supports at most two attempts per enchant family because only one free removal is available." end lastKind = entry.kind end
return { raw = compact, entries = entries, families = families, } end
local function batchParseOptions(tokens, startAt) local options = { policy = "partial", provided = {} } local index = startAt or 1 local valueOptions = { recipe = "recipeRaw", cleanup = "cleanupRaw", pass = "passAction", fail = "failAction", ["pass-to"] = "passTo", ["fail-to"] = "failTo", using = "using", }
while index <= #tokens do local keyword = tostring(tokens[index].value or ""):lower() if keyword == "strict" or keyword == "partial" then options.policy = keyword options.provided.policy = true index = index + 1 elseif keyword == "any" then return nil, "The 'any' keyword is not supported. Use 'strict' or 'partial'; partial is the default." elseif valueOptions[keyword] then local nextToken = tokens[index + 1] if not nextToken then return nil, "Missing value after '" .. keyword .. "'." end local field = valueOptions[keyword] options[field] = tostring(nextToken.value or "") options.provided[field] = true if keyword == "recipe" or keyword == "cleanup" then options.mode = keyword == "recipe" and "recipe" or "cleanup" options.provided.mode = true end index = index + 2 else return nil, "Unknown batch option '" .. tostring(tokens[index].value or "") .. "'." end end return options end
local function batchMergeOptions(template, explicit) local merged = deepCopy(template or {}) merged.provided = nil explicit = explicit or {} for key in pairs(explicit.provided or {}) do merged[key] = deepCopy(explicit[key]) end if not merged.policy or merged.policy == "" then merged.policy = "partial" end return merged end
local function batchContainerLabel(record) if not record then return "(not configured)" end if tostring(record.id) == "inventory" then return "main inventory" end local name = trim(record.name or "") return (name ~= "" and name or "container") .. " [" .. tostring(record.id or "?") .. "]" end
local function batchResolveContainer(reference, allowInventory) reference = trim(reference) if allowInventory and reference:lower() == "inventory" then return { id = "inventory", name = "main inventory" } end if reference == "" then return nil, "A container reference is required." end if not (DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.resolveContainer) == "function") then return nil, "DINV.api.resolveContainer is unavailable." end
local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.resolveContainer, reference, { source = "live", includeIgnored = true, fields = { "id", "name", "colorName", "type", "location", "container" }, }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then local reason = ok and result and (result.message or result.code) or result return nil, "Could not resolve container '" .. reference .. "': " .. tostring(reason or "unknown error") end
local item = result.item or {} local name = cleanDisplayName(stripColors(item.colorName or item.name or "container")) return { id = tostring(result.id), name = name } end
local function batchValidateSavedContainer(record, role) if not record or not record.id then local label = role:gsub("^%l", string.upper) if role == "source" then return nil, "Source container is not configured. Use 'eqb source <container>'. No batch was planned." end return nil, label .. " destination is not configured. Use 'eqb " .. role .. " <container>' or provide an explicit container ID. No batch was planned." end local resolved, err = batchResolveContainer(tostring(record.id), true) if not resolved then return nil, "Saved " .. role .. " " .. batchContainerLabel(record) .. " is unavailable: " .. tostring(err) end return resolved end
function m_Enchanter.batchConfigureContainer(role, reference) role = tostring(role or ""):lower() local containers = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers reference = trim(reference) if reference == "" then batchInfo((role:gsub("^%l", string.upper)) .. ": " .. batchContainerLabel(containers[role])) return end if reference:lower() == "clear" then containers[role] = nil m_Enchanter.saveSettings() batchInfo((role:gsub("^%l", string.upper)) .. " container cleared.") return end
local resolved, err = batchResolveContainer(reference, true) if not resolved then batchError(err) return end -- Only the canonical id and display name are persisted. Relative input such as 2.bag is never reused. containers[role] = resolved m_Enchanter.saveSettings() batchInfo((role:gsub("^%l", string.upper)) .. " set to " .. batchContainerLabel(resolved) .. ".") end
local function batchCanonicalTemplateDestination(reference) reference = trim(reference) local lower = reference:lower() if lower == "keeper" or lower == "reject" then return lower end local resolved, err = batchResolveContainer(reference, true) if not resolved then return nil, err end return tostring(resolved.id) end
local function batchTemplateReplaceCommand(name, template) local parts = { "eqb", "template", "replace", tostring(name) } if template.recipeRaw then table.insert(parts, "recipe") table.insert(parts, "{" .. tostring(template.recipeRaw) .. "}") elseif template.cleanupRaw then table.insert(parts, "cleanup") table.insert(parts, "{" .. tostring(template.cleanupRaw) .. "}") end table.insert(parts, tostring(template.policy or "partial")) if template.passAction then table.insert(parts, "pass") table.insert(parts, "{" .. tostring(template.passAction) .. "}") end if template.failAction then table.insert(parts, "fail") table.insert(parts, "{" .. tostring(template.failAction) .. "}") end if template.passTo then table.insert(parts, "pass-to") table.insert(parts, tostring(template.passTo)) end if template.failTo then table.insert(parts, "fail-to") table.insert(parts, tostring(template.failTo)) end return table.concat(parts, " ") end
function m_Enchanter.batchTemplateCommand(action, name, optionText) action = tostring(action or ""):lower() name = trim(name) local templates = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates
if action == "list" then local keys = sortedKeys(templates) if #keys == 0 then batchInfo("No batch templates are saved.") return end batchInfo("Saved batch templates:") for _, key in ipairs(keys) do local template = templates[key] local kind = template.mode and template.mode:upper() or "ACTIONS" local definition = template.recipeRaw or template.cleanupRaw or "" m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W %-22s @C%-8s@w %s", key, kind, definition)) end return end
if name == "" then batchError("A template name is required.") return end if action == "show" then local template = templates[name] if not template then batchError("Template '" .. name .. "' does not exist.") return end batchInfo("Template " .. name .. ":") m_Enchanter.print("@W Type: @G" .. tostring(template.mode or "actions") .. "@w") if template.recipeRaw then m_Enchanter.print("@W Recipe: @G" .. template.recipeRaw .. "@w") end if template.cleanupRaw then m_Enchanter.print("@W Cleanup: @G" .. template.cleanupRaw .. "@w") end m_Enchanter.print("@W Policy: @G" .. tostring(template.policy or "partial") .. "@w") if template.passAction then m_Enchanter.print("@W Pass: @G{" .. template.passAction .. "}@w") end if template.failAction then m_Enchanter.print("@W Fail: @G{" .. template.failAction .. "}@w") end if template.passTo then m_Enchanter.print("@W Pass-to: @G" .. template.passTo .. "@w") end if template.failTo then m_Enchanter.print("@W Fail-to: @G" .. template.failTo .. "@w") end m_Enchanter.print("@W command: @G" .. batchTemplateReplaceCommand(name, template) .. "@w") return elseif action == "delete" then if not templates[name] then batchError("Template '" .. name .. "' does not exist.") return end templates[name] = nil m_Enchanter.saveSettings() batchInfo("Deleted batch template '" .. name .. "'.") return end
if action ~= "save" and action ~= "replace" then batchError("Unknown template action '" .. action .. "'.") return end if not name:match("^[%w_.%-]+$") then batchError("Template names may contain only letters, numbers, underscore, dash, and period.") return end if action == "save" and templates[name] then batchError("Template '" .. name .. "' already exists. Use 'eqb template replace " .. name .. " ...' or delete it first.") return end if action == "replace" and not templates[name] then batchError("Template '" .. name .. "' does not exist. Use 'eqb template save " .. name .. " ...'.") return end
local tokens, tokenErr = batchTokenize(optionText) if not tokens then batchError(tokenErr) return end local options, optionErr = batchParseOptions(tokens, 1) if not options then batchError(optionErr) return end if options.using then batchError("A saved template cannot use another template.") return end if options.recipeRaw and options.cleanupRaw then batchError("A template cannot contain both a recipe and cleanup definition.") return end if not options.recipeRaw and not options.cleanupRaw and not options.passAction and not options.failAction and not options.passTo and not options.failTo then batchError("The template does not contain a recipe, cleanup rule, action, or destination.") return end
if options.mode then local _, parseErr = batchParseRecipe(options.recipeRaw or options.cleanupRaw, options.mode) if parseErr then batchError(parseErr) return end end for _, field in ipairs({ "passTo", "failTo" }) do if options[field] then local canonical, err = batchCanonicalTemplateDestination(options[field]) if not canonical then batchError(err) return end options[field] = canonical end end
options.provided = nil templates[name] = options m_Enchanter.saveSettings() batchInfo((action == "replace" and "Replaced" or "Saved") .. " batch template '" .. name .. "'.") end
local function batchEnchantTotal(details, kind) local total = 0 local found = false for _, entry in ipairs(details and details[kind] or {}) do local value = tostring(entry.value or "") for number in value:gmatch("[%+%-]?%d+%.?%d*") do local parsed = tonumber(number) if parsed then total = total + parsed found = true end end end return found and total or nil end
local function batchEnchantDetail(details, kind) local values = {} for _, entry in ipairs(details and details[kind] or {}) do local value = trim(entry.value) if value ~= "" then table.insert(values, value) end end return table.concat(values, ", ") end
local function batchHasFlag(item, flag) local raw = getStat(item, "flags") if type(raw) == "table" then local parts = {} for key, value in pairs(raw) do if type(key) == "number" then table.insert(parts, tostring(value)) elseif value == true or value == 1 or value == "1" then table.insert(parts, tostring(key)) end end raw = table.concat(parts, " ") end return hasToken(raw or "", flag) end
local function batchNeedsIdentify(item, analysis) -- A full DINV record is authoritative. In particular, a missing -- *removal field on a fully identified item means DINV did not classify -- that enchant as freely removable; it does not mean that another -- identify can discover more data. Treating it as incomplete caused -- permanent/non-removable enchants to be identified again on every plan. if tostring(getStat(item, "identifyLevel") or ""):lower() == "full" then return false end
local flagNames = { solidify = "solidified", illuminate = "illuminated", resonate = "resonated", } for kind, flag in pairs(flagNames) do local indicated = batchHasFlag(item, flag) or hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, kind) if indicated then if not hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, kind) or batchEnchantTotal(analysis.enchantDetails, kind) == nil or enchantRemovalMode(analysis.enchantDetails, kind) == "" then return true end end end return false end
local function batchFamilyEligible(analysis, kind) if hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, kind) then return true elseif kind == "solidify" then if analysis.hasSolidified then return false end return analysis.hasInvis == true elseif kind == "resonate" then if analysis.hasResonated then return false end return analysis.hasHum ~= true elseif kind == "illuminate" then if analysis.hasIlluminated then return false end return analysis.hasGlow ~= true end return false end
local function batchSourceContents(source) if not (DINV and DINV.api) then return nil, "DINV API is unavailable." end local options = { source = "live", includeIgnored = true, fields = { "id", "name", "colorName", "type", "flags", "identifyLevel", "location", "container", "worn", "enchants", "solidify", "solidifyremoval", "illuminate", "illuminateremoval", "resonate", "resonateremoval", }, } local fn, arg if source.id == "inventory" then fn = DINV.api.getLocationContents arg = "inventory" else fn = DINV.api.getContainerContents arg = tostring(source.id) end if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil, "This DINV version does not expose container-content queries." end local ok, result = pcall(fn, arg, options) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then return nil, tostring(ok and result and (result.message or result.code) or result or "DINV query failed") end return result.items or {} end
local function batchResolvePlanDestination(reference, role) if not reference or trim(reference) == "" then return nil end local lower = trim(reference):lower() if lower == "keeper" or lower == "reject" then local saved = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers[lower] return batchValidateSavedContainer(saved, lower) end return batchResolveContainer(reference, true) end
local function batchBuildPlan(plan) local spec, parseErr = batchParseRecipe(plan.options.recipeRaw or plan.options.cleanupRaw, plan.mode) if not spec then return nil, parseErr end plan.spec = spec plan.items = {} plan.selected = 0 plan.skipped = 0 plan.tpSkipped = 0 plan.tpItems = {} plan.cleanupRemovals = 0 plan.modifyItems = {} plan.blockedItems = {} plan.acceptableItems = {} plan.modifyBlockedOverlap = 0
local snapshots = {} for _, snapshot in pairs(plan.snapshots or {}) do table.insert(snapshots, snapshot) end table.sort(snapshots, function(a, b) local left, right = tonumber(a.id), tonumber(b.id) if left and right then return left < right end return tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.id) end)
for _, snapshot in ipairs(snapshots) do local analysis = snapshot.analysis if plan.mode == "recipe" then local families = {} local familyStates = {} local blockedFamilies = {} local eligibleCount = 0 local hasModify = false local hasBlocked = false local missing = false for _, family in ipairs(spec.families) do if batchFamilyEligible(analysis, family.kind) then eligibleCount = eligibleCount + 1 local plannedFamily = deepCopy(family) local state = { kind = family.kind, targets = deepCopy(family.targets), } if hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, family.kind) then state.observed = batchEnchantTotal(analysis.enchantDetails, family.kind) state.removal = enchantRemovalMode(analysis.enchantDetails, family.kind) local target = family.targets[1] if state.observed ~= nil and state.observed >= target then state.state = "unchanged" elseif state.removal == "enchanter" then state.state = "recast" plannedFamily.planState = state.state table.insert(families, plannedFamily) hasModify = true else state.state = "blocked" table.insert(blockedFamilies, deepCopy(state)) hasBlocked = true end else state.state = "cast" plannedFamily.planState = state.state table.insert(families, plannedFamily) hasModify = true end table.insert(familyStates, state) else missing = true table.insert(familyStates, { kind = family.kind, targets = deepCopy(family.targets), state = "unavailable", }) end end if (plan.options.policy == "strict" and missing) or eligibleCount == 0 then plan.skipped = plan.skipped + 1 else local plannedItem = { id = snapshot.id, name = analysis.plainName, colorName = analysis.colorName, originalContainer = tostring(getStat(analysis.item, "container") or getStat(analysis.item, "location") or plan.source.id), analysis = analysis, families = families, familyStates = familyStates, blockedFamilies = blockedFamilies, } table.insert(plan.items, plannedItem) if hasModify then table.insert(plan.modifyItems, plannedItem) end if hasBlocked then table.insert(plan.blockedItems, plannedItem) end if hasModify and hasBlocked then plan.modifyBlockedOverlap = plan.modifyBlockedOverlap + 1 elseif not hasModify and not hasBlocked then local function batchPlanFromTokens(mode, tokens, selectorIndex) local selector = tokens[selectorIndex] and tostring(tokens[selectorIndex].value or ""):lower() or "" local source local optionsAt if selector == "source" then local saved = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.containers.source local err source, err = batchValidateSavedContainer(saved, "source") if not source then batchError(err) return end optionsAt = selectorIndex + 1 elseif selector == "container" then local reference = tokens[selectorIndex + 1] and tokens[selectorIndex + 1].value or "" if trim(reference) == "" then batchError("Usage: eqb " .. (mode == "cleanup" and "cleanup " or "") .. "plan container <container> ...") return end local err source, err = batchResolveContainer(reference, true) if not source then batchError(err) return end optionsAt = selectorIndex + 2 else batchError("Choose 'source' or 'container <container>' after plan.") return end
local explicit, optionErr = batchParseOptions(tokens, optionsAt) if not explicit then batchError(optionErr) return end if explicit.recipeRaw and explicit.cleanupRaw then batchError("A job cannot contain both recipe and cleanup definitions.") return end
local template local templateName = explicit.using if explicit.using then template = m_Enchanter.settings.batch.templates[explicit.using] if not template then batchError("Template '" .. explicit.using .. "' does not exist.") return end end local options = batchMergeOptions(template, explicit) options.using = nil if mode == "recipe" then if options.mode and options.mode ~= "recipe" then batchError("Enchant plans need a recipe template, but '" .. tostring(templateName or "that template") .. Run it with 'eqb cleanup plan ...' instead.") return end options.mode = "recipe" if not options.recipeRaw then batchError("An enchant plan needs 'recipe {FLAGS}' or a recipe template.") return end else if options.mode and options.mode ~= "cleanup" then batchError("Cleanup plans need a cleanup template, but '" .. tostring(templateName or "that template") .. function m_Enchanter.batchCommand(raw) raw = trim(raw) if raw == "" or raw:lower() == "help" then m_Enchanter.showBatchHelp() return end local lower = raw:lower() if lower == "examples" or lower == "help examples" then m_Enchanter.showBatchExamples() return elseif lower == "placeholders" or lower == "help placeholders" then m_Enchanter.showBatchPlaceholders() return elseif lower == "status" then m_Enchanter.batchStatus() return elseif lower == "start" then m_Enchanter.batchStart() return elseif lower == "pause" then m_Enchanter.batchPause() return elseif lower == "resume" then m_Enchanter.batchResume() return elseif lower == "abort" then m_Enchanter.batchAbort() return end
local listCategory = lower:match("^list%s+(%S+)%s*$") if listCategory then m_Enchanter.batchShowPlanItems(listCategory) return end
local role, reference = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") role = role and role:lower() or nil if role == "source" or role == "keeper" or role == "reject" then m_Enchanter.batchConfigureContainer(role:lower(), reference) return end
local templateAction, templateName, templateOptions = raw:match("^template%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(.+)$") templateAction = templateAction and templateAction:lower() or nil if templateAction == "save" or templateAction == "replace" then m_Enchanter.batchTemplateCommand(templateAction, templateName, templateOptions) return end templateAction, templateName = raw:match("^template%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") templateAction = templateAction and templateAction:lower() or nil if templateAction == "show" or templateAction == "delete" then m_Enchanter.batchTemplateCommand(templateAction, templateName, "") return end if lower == "template list" then m_Enchanter.batchTemplateCommand("list", "", "") return end
